Subject: Evaluation timeline + MAP questions

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are lining up an internal evaluation and need a clear mutual action plan so we can get legal and procurement moving. High level:
- 8-week evaluation window starting early May
- Target close by end of June if MAP milestones are met
- Key asks from our side: 90-day observability retention for logs/metrics during pilot, 24x7 premium support credits to cover ramp, and clarity on how discounts kick in as we hit commit milestones (ramp to 50M tokens/month).

Can you send a stage-gated MAP we can share with the procurement team? Also need a SOW draft and a sample invoice.

Thanks,

Hi Elena — great to hear this is moving so quickly. Attached is a stage-gated MAP (redwood-map-proposal-v3.pdf) and a preliminary SOW. Highlights:

- Evaluation (Week 0–2): onboarding, baseline perf tests, KV cache & batching config. Redwood provides 30k test-query credits and 30 days observability retention for pilot telemetry.
- Pilot milestone (Week 3–4): integration success criteria (latency p50/p95 targets, token cost per 1k). If met, InsightApps signs a short-term commit to 10M tokens/month for 3 months.
- Ramp milestone (Week 5–8): commit increases to 50M tokens/month with staged discounts (5% at 25M, 12% at 50M).

Commercial levers we can offer for closing by June:
- Observability retention upgrade: add-on to move to 90 days during pilot (one-time fee) or included with a 6-month commit.
- Premium support credits: we can include 3 months of premium support hours upfront as credits for first 90 days for pilots that convert to a commit.
- One-time onboarding credit for evaluation customers that commit by 2026-06-30.

I tagged the places in the PDF where pricing changes based on the chosen retention option. If you want the 90-day retention included for the pilot with no one-time fee, we can trade that for a small accelerated commit (10M for 2 months up front) — let me know which option procurement prefers and I’ll update the SOW.

Attachments: redwood-map-proposal-v3.pdf, SOW-InsightApps-draft.docx

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen

Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Evaluation timeline + MAP questions (internal)

Stephanie — quick internal note on options:

1) 90-day observability for pilot at no fee — operational cost looks ~ $6k one-time (storage/ingest). We can cover if the customer signs 6-month 25M commit instead of the 3-month 10M.
2) Premium support credits (3 months) are fine; we should limit SRE escalation to X hours/month to control cost.
3) Discount cadence is OK, but require a minimum ramp clause: if they don’t reach 25M by month 6, discounts step down. Fine to mirror that in the SOW.

I attached an annotated SOW with the two pricing variants. If Stephanie wants option A (free retention for 6-month commit) I’ll prep final numbers and finance sign-off.

Attachment: SOW-InsightApps-draft.docx

-Aditya

Elena / Markus — attaching an updated MAP and two commercial options (see SOW pages 2–4):

Option A (Accelerated close — Preferred):
- 6-month committed contract at 25M tokens/month.
- 90-day observability retention included for the pilot and full contract.
- 12% discount once commit sustained at 50M for any month in the first 6 months.
- 3 months premium support credits included.
- One-time onboarding credit applied at signing.

Option B (Lower entry):
- 3-month starter commit at 10M tokens/month, then ramp to 50M.
- 30-day default observability retention; 90-day as add-on fee.
- Discount cadence as previously described (5% @25M, 12% @50M).

Asks / timeline:
- Please confirm preferred option by EOD May 10 to hit a June 30 commercial close.
- If Option A is chosen, I’ll kick off DocuSign SOW and share an invoice sample for procurement.
